post.text:
Miley Cyrus’s boyfriend Max revealed that after marriage, he plans to take her last name instead of asking her to change.

“She’s built an iconic name and brand since she was 12, it would be wrong to ask her to give that up. I’d rather take her name and stand behind her legacy.” https://t.co/E2i2kQz3cl

description.description: A professional photograph captures Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando seated at a table during an indoor event. Miley, on the left, is wearing a black leather moto-style jacket over a white collared shirt and black trousers, smiling at the camera. Maxx Morando, on the right with dark wavy hair and a mustache, wears a black t-shirt and has his arm around her. They are seated at a circular table with a reddish-pink marble-patterned top. In the background, other event attendees are visible in a dimly lit setting.

A man with curly hair and sunglasses stands next to Miley Cyrus on a purple carpet. They are posing in front of a purple backdrop featuring a line of vanity lights and various brand logos. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and black pants, while Miley Cyrus is wearing a silver sequined skirt and a white graphic top with a sparkly overlay.
